title: How to Consolidate Reviews From Multiple Channels
summary: See how to consolidate guest reviews from multiple booking channels into one dashboard view.
body_markdown:
Consolidating reviews from multiple channels means scores and feedback from every booking platform your properties are listed on come together into one dashboard, instead of checking each platform separately to get a full picture. In **Jestor** , this works by connecting available review data into the same structured, connected view used for other operational indicators.


Properties listed across several booking platforms accumulate review data in as many separate places — making it genuinely hard to see a single, combined satisfaction picture without manually checking each one.


## What fragmented multi-channel reviews cost


- Checking multiple platforms individually to get a full satisfaction picture
- No single combined score representing performance across all channels
- Difficulty spotting a property-specific issue that shows up differently per platform
- No trend view combining review data with internal operational data like response time


## How consolidated review tracking works


- Available review data can connect into the same structure as other property data
- Composite indicators can combine scores across channels into one view
- This can connect to internal SLA and issue data for a fuller satisfaction picture
- Dashboards surface trends per property and across the portfolio


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- One dashboard can combine review data with internal operational indicators
- Property-level and portfolio-level views draw from the same connected structure
- Trends become visible over time, not just individual platform snapshots
- Non-technical property managers can view or adjust these dashboards directly


Fragmented review checking Consolidated review dashboard


Checked per platform individually Combined into one view


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this pull review data automatically from every booking platform?** That depends on available integrations for each specific platform. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can review data connect to internal SLA and issue tracking?** Yes, into the same connected dashboard structure.


**Can I see review trends per property over time?** Yes, through dashboards built on the consolidated data.
